finding: Chunks are exclusive (0 shared). First touch in a process still SHA-256s 9.384 GiB (3183 invocations, 0 cache hits); that is why a new-process body stays streaming_io-dominated at 16.32s. A resident second token skips every hash: 25.523s -> 5.763s (4.43x). Hash-once is the cost on a dirty/resident loop. mmap + new_buffer_no_copy did not make first-touch under 20% faster on a warm page cache; skip-hash did.
